Visible dirt, grime, and some red markings on the plastic.
A black electrical wiring harness with a connector is attached to the side.
The tank is shown in a workshop or garage environment with cardboard boxes in the background.
No brand name, model, or capacity markings are legible on the tank in any photo.

claims.evidence: No Hyundai branding or model-specific markings are visible in the photos.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or the Hyundai logo on the tank.

risks.risk: The internal pump or electronic sensor may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the pump activating and the sensor sending a signal.
risks.if_unproven: as a standard plastic tank only

risks.risk: The tank may be empty or have significant internal contamination.
risks.proof: A photo of the tank with a clear view of the interior and the fill line.
risks.if_unproven: as a used tank with unknown capacity

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the tank.
Photo of the interior of the tank.
Video of the pump and sensor working.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
